lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Rose, please don't lose that tooth until I'm back. I want to see the hole.
lines.script: [pleading, wistful] Rose, please don't lose that tooth until I'm back. [admitting] I want to see the hole.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Then we have ten minutes! I'll take all ten. I have so much to tell you.
lines.script: [seizing it] Then we have ten minutes! [nit picky] I'll take all TEN. [bursting to tell] I have so much to tell you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A fish on Long Island jumped out of the water and froze in the air, inside one of those orange blocks. It's still hanging up there!
lines.script: [storytelling, building] A fish on Long Island jumped out of the water and FROZE in the air, inside one of those orange blocks. [amazed] It's still hanging up there!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It's just hanging in the air? Babe! That's a flying fish!
lines.script: [skeptical] It's just hanging in the air? [punchline, delighted] Babe! That's a FLYING fish!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And he's got more air time than you do.
lines.script: [teasing] And he's got more air time than YOU do.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nobody has more air time than me. He's seven feet up. I was at thirty-six thousand.
lines.script: [offended] NOBODY has more air time than me. [nit picky, correcting] He's seven feet up. [bragging] I was at thirty-six thousand.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: And my mother made a rule. Nobody in the family goes anywhere alone, and that goes for Los Angeles too.
lines.script: [reporting, earnest] And my mother made a rule. [quoting her] Nobody in the family goes anywhere alone, and that goes for Los Angeles TOO.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Nobody in the family. Does that count me?
lines.script: [repeating, careful] Nobody in the family. [hopeful, trying to sound casual] Does that count me?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You were the first one I thought of.
lines.script: [reassuring, immediate] You were the FIRST one I thought of.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Then it's a good thing I got you this.
lines.script: [pleased, setting it up] Then it's a good thing I got you THIS.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A lanyard! With my name on it! It's LAMINATED!
lines.script: [gasping, thrilled] A lanyard! [reading it, amazed] With my name on it! [punchline, shouting] It's LAMINATED!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Of course it's laminated. I wanted this to last.
lines.script: [stating the obvious, fond] Of course it's laminated. [sincere] I wanted this to last.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Do I have to give it back?
lines.script: [worried, small] Do I have to give it back?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Never. Where I go, you go. That's Deedee's rule. So stick close, babe, and don't leave me hanging like that fish.
lines.script: [tender] Never. [quoting the rule] Where I go, you go. That's Deedee's rule. [punchline] So stick close, babe, and don't leave me HANGING like that fish.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Very, very important. I have a lanyard. And now so do you.
lines.script: [mock serious] Very, VERY important. [bragging] I have a lanyard. [sweet] And now so do you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: She has to come. Nobody goes anywhere alone. Does she get a lanyard?
lines.script: [insisting] She has to come. [citing the rule] Nobody goes anywhere alone. [hopeful] Does SHE get a lanyard?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I only had one spare badge.
lines.script: [apologizing, nonchalant] I only had one spare badge.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It says STUNT DOUBLE. Whose stunt double is she?
lines.script: [reading it, delighted] It says STUNT DOUBLE. [curious] Whose stunt double is she?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: The horse's.
lines.script: [punchline, deadpan] The horse's.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nara! You're in the movies!
lines.script: [thrilled, announcing] Nara! You're in the MOVIES!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Hello, Ray. I'm Tom. I'm a visitor. It says so right here.
lines.script: [introducing himself, overly polite] Hello, Ray. I'm Tom. [bragging] I'm a visitor. [showing off] It says so right HERE.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He didn't even look at it.
lines.script: [crushed, quiet] He didn't even LOOK at it.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: He never looks. But you held it up beautifully.
lines.script: [consoling] He never looks. [sincere, admiring] But you held it up BEAUTIFULLY.

lines.speaker: Kiki
lines.text: It was right there in Stage 7. Then there was a HUGE flash, and the fog machine turned itself on, and the lights went out, and things started CLAPPING.
lines.script: [panicking, rambling] It was right there in Stage 7. Then there was a HUGE flash, and the fog machine turned itself on, and the lights went out, [shrill, disbelief] and things started CLAPPING.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A flash! What kind of flash?
lines.script: [alarmed, recognizing] A flash! [interrogating] What KIND of flash?

lines.speaker: Kiki
lines.text: I thought it was lightning for the storm scene. We don't HAVE a storm scene!
lines.script: [explaining, frantic] I thought it was lightning for the storm scene. [punchline, panicking] We don't HAVE a storm scene!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I've seen grumpy things like that! On my street, and at my parents' pond. They always show up right after a flash.
lines.script: [vouching, serious] I've seen grumpy things like that! [listing] On my street, and at my parents' pond. [informing] They ALWAYS show up right after a flash.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: You've seen them before? Wonderful. You're hired.
lines.script: [skeptical] You've seen them before? [relieved] Wonderful. [punchline, snappy] You're hired.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'm hired! I've been a visitor for one hour!
lines.script: [astonished] I'm HIRED! [nit picky, proud] I've been a visitor for one hour!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: She's the stunt double! She has a badge!
lines.script: [defending her] She's the stunt double! [citing proof] She has a BADGE!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You can tell it's grape from one sniff?
lines.script: [impressed, skeptical] You can tell it's grape from ONE sniff?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe. I'd know grape anywhere. It's my favorite color and my favorite flavor.
lines.script: [certain] Babe. I'd know grape ANYWHERE. [punchline, nonchalant] It's my favorite color and my favorite flavor.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Stage 7 is locked from the inside, though. And every set out here has one of those grumpy things on it, wrecking the shoot. The crew can't work like this.
lines.script: [reporting, worried] Stage 7 is locked from the inside, though. [explaining] And every set out here has one of those grumpy things on it, wrecking the shoot. [serious] The crew can't work like this.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Then we get them off the sets, one at a time: Main Street, the Western street and New York. After that we deal with Stage 7.
lines.script: [taking charge] Then we get them off the sets, ONE at a time: [listing, precise] Main Street, the Western street and New York. [deciding] After that we deal with Stage 7.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That crab is made of cue cards! And it's holding one up for us to read!
lines.script: [amazed] That crab is made of CUE cards! [delighted] And it's holding one up for us to read!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Excuse me, Mr. Crab. Do you have a card that says PLEASE COME IN?
lines.script: [overly polite] Excuse me, Mr. Crab. [hopeful, requesting] Do you have a card that says PLEASE COME IN?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe, I think we're on the wrong side of the cards.
lines.script: [punchline, wry] Babe, I think we're on the wrong side of the CARDS.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He goes first? All right. Rules are rules. Where's my mark? I'd like to stand on my mark.
lines.script: [accepting] He goes first? All right. [citing the rule] Rules are rules. [eager, fussing] Where's my mark? I'd like to stand on my MARK.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe, you're not in the movie.
lines.script: [gently correcting] Babe, you're not IN the movie.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I have a lanyard!
lines.script: [punchline, protesting] I have a LANYARD!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Stand down, Nara. The horse is doing his own stunts today.
lines.script: [giving an order, amused] Stand down, Nara. [punchline] The horse is doing his OWN stunts today.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I like the click. That's how I know you're home.
lines.script: [tender, admitting] I like the click. [sweet] That's how I know you're home.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Cover your ears, babe. When a boom mic screeches, nobody can get a word out.
lines.script: [warning, urgent] Cover your ears, babe. [explaining] When a boom mic screeches, NOBODY can get a word out.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's very dark in here. Could you hold my lanyard?
lines.script: [nervous, small] It's VERY dark in here. [punchline, overly polite] Could you hold my lanyard?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I've got your lanyard, babe.
lines.script: [reassuring, tender] I've got your lanyard, babe.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Blue, orange, red. And one strip of gaffer tape. Okay, two. Okay, four.
lines.script: [confident, listing] Blue, orange, red. And ONE strip of gaffer tape. [admitting] Okay, two. [punchline, confessing] Okay, four.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You fixed a whole soundstage with tape! Can you fix my knees?
lines.script: [impressed] You fixed a whole SOUNDSTAGE with tape! [punchline, hopeful] Can you fix my knees?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Hold on. One of the lights must still be out. That whole patch of floor is grey.
lines.script: [nonchalant] Hold on. One of the lights must still be out. [noticing, puzzled] That whole patch of floor is grey.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's not the lights. Look up. Every one of them is on.
lines.script: [correcting, quiet] It's not the lights. [directing] Look up. [certain] Every one of them is ON.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Then why is my table grey? And the floor? And my tape marks?
lines.script: [confused] Then why is my table grey? [getting worried] And the floor? [panicking] And my tape marks?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe. That's the hero hat. The cowboy wears it in every scene of the movie. And it's inside a big orange block!
lines.script: [rattled] Babe. That's the hero hat. [explaining, urgent] The cowboy wears it in every scene of the movie. [disbelief] And it's inside a big orange BLOCK!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's just like the dragonfly, the lemon and the fish. And every one is bigger than the last.
lines.script: [recognizing, uneasy] It's just like the dragonfly, the lemon and the fish. [working it out, slowly] And every one is BIGGER than the last.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Well, hats off to whoever did this. No, really. I can't get the hat off.
lines.script: [punchline, rattled] Well, HATS off to whoever did this. [admitting, flat] No, really. I can't get the hat off.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: There's going to be a little round hole in the side.
lines.script: [predicting, calm] There's going to be a little round hole in the side.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: There it is.
lines.script: [confirming, satisfied] There it is.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: And there's going to be a burnt flashbulb on the floor, somewhere close.
lines.script: [predicting, calm] And there's going to be a burnt flashbulb on the floor, somewhere close.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: You knew exactly where to look. Babe, how are you this good at it?
lines.script: [amazed] You knew EXACTLY where to look. [uneasy, admiring] Babe, how are you this good at it?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I've had three practices. And I've lost a pulling contest to a plum, a grapefruit and a watermelon. I'm not pulling on a beach ball.
lines.script: [stating the facts] I've had three practices. [admitting, listing] And I've lost a pulling contest to a plum, a grapefruit and a watermelon. [punchline, refusing] I'm NOT pulling on a beach ball.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Then I'll just move the table.
lines.script: [undeterred, nonchalant] Then I'll just move the table.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I moved the table. The hat didn't come with it.
lines.script: [reporting, stunned] I moved the table. [disbelief, slowly] The hat... didn't come WITH it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's what the fish does!
lines.script: [recognizing, excited] That's what the FISH does!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I don't like it. Put the table back. I want the table back under it right now.
lines.script: [rattled] I don't like it. [ordering] Put the table back. [pleading, panicking] I want the table back under it right NOW.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Thank you. That's better. That's a hat on a table. That's normal.
lines.script: [relieved, shaky] Thank you. That's better. [convincing himself] That's a hat on a table. [punchline, insisting] That's NORMAL.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Hat: grey floor, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb. I'm sending it to Amy for Grace. She keeps the list in her notebook.
lines.script: [dictating, precise] Hat: grey floor, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb. [explaining] I'm sending it to Amy for Grace. She keeps the list in her notebook.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Who brings a flashbulb onto a movie set? We have four hundred lights in here and not one of them is that.
lines.script: [baffled] Who brings a flashbulb onto a movie set? [punchline, nit picky] We have four HUNDRED lights in here and not one of them is that.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: That came from the stage set. And that's where the wheel tracks go.
lines.script: [alert, hushed] That came from the stage set. [working it out] And THAT'S where the wheel tracks go.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That megaphone is as big as a refrigerator! And it's sitting on your costumes!
lines.script: [shouting, shocked] That megaphone is as big as a REFRIGERATOR! [scandalized] And it's sitting on your costumes!

lines.speaker: The Director’s Cut
lines.text: This morning there was a big flash down on the floor. Now I'm big enough to do my own yelling.
lines.script: [booming, explaining] This morning there was a big flash down on the floor. [bragging] Now I'm big enough to do my OWN yelling.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Excuse me, sir. Those are his costumes. He steamed all forty by hand. While humming.
lines.script: [overly polite, firm] Excuse me, sir. [correcting] Those are HIS costumes. [vouching, proud] He steamed all forty by hand. [punchline, earnest] While humming.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And look at the beret. That's a gold coin.
lines.script: [noticing, quiet] And look at the beret. [recognizing] That's a gold COIN.

lines.speaker: The Director’s Cut
lines.text: That's my AWARD. I found it on the floor. Forty years on this lot, and it's my first one.
lines.script: [booming, defensive] That's my AWARD. [justifying] I found it on the floor. [admitting, lonely] Forty years on this lot, and it's my first one.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We are. We have lanyards.
lines.script: [confirming, firm] We are. [punchline, citing proof] We have LANYARDS.

lines.speaker: The Director’s Cut
lines.text: If I can get a "great take", somebody else should get the award. Best costumes. It goes to the skinny one with the tape.
lines.script: [booming, reasoning] If I can get a "great take", somebody else should get the award. [announcing] Best costumes. [presenting, generous] It goes to the skinny one with the TAPE.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I've never won anything! I'd like to thank my steamer. I'd like to thank my tape.
lines.script: [overwhelmed] I've never won ANYTHING! [giving a speech, shaky] I'd like to thank my steamer. I'd like to thank my tape.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And I'd like to thank my babe, who flew two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles to watch me work.
lines.script: [giving a speech, tender] And I'd like to thank my babe, who flew [precise, loving] two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles to watch me work.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He said the right number!
lines.script: [punchline, thrilled] He said the RIGHT number!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It has a cowboy hat on it. Rose has a dragonfly, I have a lemon, and my father has a fish.
lines.script: [examining, quiet] It has a cowboy hat on it. [tallying] Rose has a dragonfly, I have a lemon, and my father has a fish.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And now I have a hat. Babe, I love my award. I don't love that there are four of them.
lines.script: [happy, tallying] And now I have a hat. [gushing] Babe, I LOVE my award. [admitting, uneasy] I don't love that there are four of them.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It's not a frisbee, Nara. It's an award.
lines.script: [gently correcting] It's not a frisbee, Nara. [punchline, proud] It's an AWARD.

lines.speaker: The Director’s Cut
lines.text: The lighting was too flat. Nobody asked me. But it was.
lines.script: [booming, grumbling] The lighting was too flat. [sulking] Nobody asked me. [insisting, quieter] But it was.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Help me push. This thing has four wheels and four opinions.
lines.script: [recruiting, nonchalant] Help me push. [punchline, dry] This thing has four wheels and four OPINIONS.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: The hero hat is still stuck in there. Good thing wardrobe always has a double.
lines.script: [reporting, nonchalant] The hero hat is still stuck in there. [punchline, wry] Good thing wardrobe always has a DOUBLE.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A backup hat! You're the most prepared man I know. And I set two alarms for everything.
lines.script: [impressed] A backup hat! [admiring] You're the most prepared man I know. [punchline, nit picky] And I set TWO alarms for everything.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I always keep one under my hat.
lines.script: [punchline, deadpan] I always keep one under my HAT.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Finders keepers. I'm calling it best costumes.
lines.script: [claiming it, cheerful] Finders keepers. [deciding] I'm calling it best costumes.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Two awards in one day, babe. I'm on a hot steam streak.
lines.script: [tallying, proud] Two awards in one day, babe. [punchline] I'm on a hot STEAM streak.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: And crew jackets. Wrap Party Jackets. Only the crew gets one. You're crew now. Even the stunt double.
lines.script: [announcing, brisk] And crew jackets. Wrap Party Jackets. [laying down the rule] Only the crew gets one. [including them] You're crew now. [punchline, dry] Even the stunt double.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A second lanyard! I have TWO lanyards!
lines.script: [gasping] A second lanyard! [punchline, shouting] I have TWO lanyards!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Steam-ulating! I flew two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles for that pun.
lines.script: [delighted, repeating the pun] STEAM-ulating! [nit picky, amused annoyed] I flew two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles for that pun.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Worth it. Every mile. I'd have flown them for zero puns.
lines.script: [admitting, tender] Worth it. Every mile. [punchline, sweet] I'd have flown them for ZERO puns.

lines.speaker: Toni
lines.text: Not next to the cake! ...Fine. She's crew.
lines.script: [alarmed, scolding] Not next to the CAKE! [giving in, grudging] ...Fine. She's crew.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's Amy. "Grace put the hat on page three. Also, parent-teacher conference night is Thursday. Thirty parents. I need backup. Bring snacks. And bring the good uncle."
lines.script: [announcing] It's Amy. [reading aloud, brisk] "Grace put the hat on page three. Also, parent-teacher conference night is Thursday. Thirty parents. I need backup. Bring snacks. [punchline, dry] And bring the GOOD uncle."

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Go. But nobody goes anywhere alone, so take my picture for the plane.
lines.script: [letting him go, warm] Go. [citing the rule, teasing] But nobody goes anywhere alone, so take my PICTURE for the plane.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's the one I'm looking at for six hours.
lines.script: [tender, admitting] That's the one I'm looking at for SIX hours.
